versions.changelog:
- Added detailed usage instructions, including trigger methods and execution flow.
- Expanded privacy and publishing safeguards—content now returns as Markdown by default; publishing to ima requires explicit user confirmation and data review.
- Included step-by-step publishing process with security prompts and post-publish feedback.
- Added concrete usage examples to clarify expected inputs and outputs.
- Clarified that knowledge-base Q&A relies strictly on authorized knowledge sources and citation protocols.

vc-lp-knowledge 1.0.0

- Initial release of the VC LP knowledge management skill.
- Provides structured support for creating LP quarterly report highlights, fund performance summaries, and fundraising materials.
- Enables knowledge-based Q&A with mandatory source citations for VC investment topics.
- Ensures all outputs (reports and Q&A) are professional, traceable, and reference-backed; no fabricated content.
- Delivers Markdown-formatted outputs and supports publishing to ima knowledge channels.
